Knowledge facts: part C holds 46 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 18 to 28; part C2 holds 21 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised 06/2024 cover edition, the required vision, knowledge and skills tests and the knowledge test content from physical pages 1 and 15 to 17; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- SC-LICB-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-LICB-A-PASS — knowledge-test passing score not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-LICB-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-LICB-A-FRESH — possibly newer unlinked manual upload not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-LICB-D-DUI — provisional-license DUI cutoff and current alcohol-suspension relief not confirmed after the edition date (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- SC-LICB-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- SC-LICB-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: fees, mailing addresses, renewal delivery times and payment plan rules (for example sec02-F08, sec02-F22, sec02-F24) can change and must be refreshed from the SCDMV website.
